detours.why: Neyland Drive and the rail line between West Campus and the Agricultural Campus have one mapped crossing, by the aquatic center; walks go south-east to it and back west.
Beacon Hall's mapped way out is north to the Lake Avenue side; no mapped path runs down the slope south to Presidential Court, Rocky Top, HPER and Temple, so walks go round by the streets.

No doors are mapped on Stokely, Fred D. Brown, Geier, Robinson, Hess, Magnolia or Torchbearer, nor on most buildings they walk to (Volunteer Hall's only mapped door is its garage entrance), so each walk runs between the mapped paths nearest the buildings' middles or doors, which here lie on their far sides; the walk goes round the building to reach them.
